subject: Had something similar while
author: YabobK34
body: Had something similar while doing bike challenges yesterday. It started during a timed challenge where we were supposed to get jump distance in Palm Bay Heights and then race to the Observatory. When I got the Observatory (last one there) he was still down in Palm Bay Heights on the map. The game did however show that he had done his part and was there, but when I looked around at the other players he was nowhere to be seen (so it's not quiet the same as what you have experienced). I didn't see him again for the rest of the session, but it always showed up that he did his part.
